In my experience, I have found using the reverse method for a micro plane has helped me keep a faster and cleaner work station when doing multiple plates (near the 180-250 area) 

I used to work in banquets and some salads or soups (and definitely pastas) would be garnished with fresh grated parm. Using the micro plane upside down let’s you see exactly how much cheese (or whatever) you are grating for portioning and the curved edges keeps it nice and inside the plane. A quick tilt keeps the cheese from flying everywhere and the motion is pretty fluid.

While that method is a little slower than the traditional, I find that the net time saved from cleaning the plates up before they are served is positive compared to the traditional at that scale.
